SELECT AVG(post_count) AS average_posts_voted
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS post_count
    FROM votes v
    JOIN users u ON v.XCL_070 = u.XCL_052
    WHERE u.XCL_054 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_054) FROM users)
    GROUP BY u.XCL_052
)
